title: MAPPING PATIENT-PERCEIVED PHYSICIAN TRAITS FROM NATIONWIDE ONLINE REVIEWS WITH LLMS

bias_targets.methodology: Statistical comparison of LLM-extracted physician trait scores (Big Five personality traits and patient-oriented subjective judgments) between male and female physicians to identify systemic disparities in patient evaluations.
Comparing LLM-extracted trait distributions across different medical specialties using one-way ANOVA to identify evaluation biases driven by the context and nature of the medical encounters.
